```{r setup, include=FALSE}

```

```{r, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
cat("Work through the evaluation report one section at a time. For each section,\n")
cat("rate its credibility and give the one reason that decided your rating. The\n")
cat("reason matters more than the colour: a red with no reason is an opinion, and an\n")
cat("amber with a named caveat is a finding.\n\n")

cat("# The scale\n\n")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(rating_scale))) {
  cat(sprintf("- **%s.** %s\n", rating_scale$light[i], rating_scale$meaning[i]))
}
cat("\n")

cat("# Sections to rate\n\n")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(rating_sections))) {
  cat(sprintf("## %s\n\n", rating_sections$section[i]))
  cat("Rating (circle one):  **Green**   /   **Amber**   /   **Red**\n\n")
  cat("The reason that decided it:\n\n")
  cat("......................................................................................\n\n")
  cat("......................................................................................\n\n")
  cat("If amber or red, what would settle it:\n\n")
  cat("......................................................................................\n\n")
}

cat("\\newpage\n\n")

cat("# Your verdict\n\n")
cat("Would you sign off on this evaluation for national scale-up?\n\n")
cat("  **Yes**   /   **No**   /   **Not without more answers**\n\n")
cat("The single most important problem you found:\n\n")
cat("......................................................................................\n\n")
cat("......................................................................................\n\n")
cat("The strongest thing in the report, and why it does not rescue the above:\n\n")
cat("......................................................................................\n\n")
cat("......................................................................................\n\n")

cat("# What changed your mind\n\n")
cat("How did your rating of the executive summary compare with your rating of the\n")
cat("results section? If they differ, the report has done something to you.\n\n")
cat("......................................................................................\n\n")
cat("......................................................................................\n\n")
cat("......................................................................................\n\n")
```
